prose: Tonight we'll be demystifying the work of the late George "Doc Rhino" Thompson, known by police cadet trainees and corpo-ladder climbers as Verbal Judo. What are the effective tools for communication for conflict de-escalation? What do society's occult engineers know about manufacturing consent and self-incrimination? Join Slick Dissident and me for a look at the good, bad, and ugly of tactical speech.
